provenance: Recorded on an Apple M5 Pro with 48 GB of memory. This page replays saved timings. Nothing runs in your browser.

headline.label: adaptive against the best fixed length

claims.title: The output follows the large model
claims.text: The sampler is checked by enumerating every path on small cases, and by 1500 draws per arm on real weights. Its p-values ran from 0.08 to 0.61, and a deliberately wrong sampler failed the same test.

claims.title: The test prompts stayed unseen
claims.text: These hotel, bookstore and parking receipt families were held out of training and tuning, and every setting was frozen before they ran.

claims.title: The main claim failed
claims.text: Adaptive needed a 95 percent interval above 1.00 against the best fixed length. It came in at 0.87 to 0.97, so the claim is not supported. A well tuned fixed length wins when the text looks like what it was tuned for.

claims.title: Adaptive protects against the wrong tuning
claims.text: On text the draft was not trained for, the same fixed length fell to 0.37x of the large model alone. Adaptive shortened its drafts and held 0.87x.
